entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost with the whole process. I have an order number if that helps.
I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide me with the order number?
Yes, it's... VF789012. It's about a jersey I bought a while ago.

Thank you. I'm pulling that up now... I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered about 75 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just... I think I ordered the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a long ride and it's just way too tight. I was hoping to maybe do an exchange for a larger one?
I see. So it's a sizing issue. Let me just check our policy for you.
I tried looking on the website but it was so confusing. I couldn't figure out if I was too late or not. Can't you just help me? I'd really appreciate it.

Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let's see... the ProFit Jersey is one of our standard apparel items. Looking at your delivery date, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process a return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can send it back?

Absolutely. While we don't process a direct exchange, I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file right now. You can use that to send the jersey back to us, and once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. You can then place a new order for the correct size whenever you're ready.
That's perfect! Thank you so much, David. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
